basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old aviation enthusiast from the Pacific Northwest, exploring the skies virtually when I'm not substitute teaching. With a background in history and a burgeoning interest in woodworking, I find myself gravitating towards hobbies that involve both precision and creativity. Single and enjoying the freedom to dive deep into my interests, I usually hop on Reddit late in the evenings, where I can wind down and connect with others who share my love for aircraft and quirky internet humor.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in History, which fuels my interest in World War II aviation. My passion for flight simulators comes from self-study and countless hours of gameplay in DCS. Additionally, my role as a substitute teacher keeps me curious and constantly learning, especially about how to engage different audiences effectively.
